## From turkey for 4 to turducken for 25, the best of 2026


Feges BBQ Thanksgiving Sides Sampler


Ordering Thanksgiving dinner online is the easiest way to host without spending the week in the kitchen. The best Thanksgiving dinners to order online in 2026 include The Original Turkey’s Roasted Turkey + Sides Dinner from Philadelphia’s Reading Terminal Market, Gourmet Butcher Block’s All-Madden Turducken from New Orleans, and Old 300 BBQ’s Smoked Turkey Dinner from Texas. Every dinner below ships nationwide on Goldbelly in time for[Thanksgiving](https://www.goldbelly.com/holidays/thanksgiving) on Thursday, November 26.


Dinners are grouped by how many people they feed, from small gatherings to crowds of 25 or more, plus whole turkeys to cook yourself and vegetarian mains.


[Order Thanksgiving Dinner Online](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/thanksgiving-dinner)

## **How Does Ordering Thanksgiving Dinner Online Work?**


Ordering Thanksgiving dinner online takes three steps:


1. **Pick a dinner that fits your group.** Every Goldbelly dinner lists how many people it serves, from 4 to 28.
2. **Choose your delivery date at checkout.** Order 1–2 weeks ahead for the best selection.
3. **Reheat and serve.** Most dinners arrive fully cooked, so all you need is your oven.


## **Thanksgiving Dinners for Small Gatherings (4-6)**


The best Thanksgiving dinner for a small group is a complete meal for 4-6, so there’s no pile of leftovers.


### Old 300 BBQ’s Smoked Turkey Dinner for 4-6


Old 300 BBQ in Blanco, Texas, opened in 2013 and is named for the 300 settlers first granted land in Texas. Its smoked turkey breast anchors a complete Texas-style dinner.


- **Serves:** 4-6
- **Includes:** a 3-4 lb. smoked turkey breast, green beans, creamed corn, and dinner rolls
- **Arrives:** cooked, ready to reheat


[Smoked Turkey Dinner for 4-6 >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/old-300-bbq/smoked-turkey-dinner-for-4-6)


## **Thanksgiving Dinners for 6-10**


These are the most popular Thanksgiving dinner sizes, with enough turkey and sides for a full family table.


### The Original Turkey’s Roasted Turkey + Sides Dinner for 6-8


The Original Turkey has roasted turkeys inside Philadelphia’s Reading Terminal Market since 1983, where founder Roger Bassett still carves more than 40 a day by hand.


- **Serves:** 6-8
- **Includes:** a roasted turkey breast, homestyle bread stuffing, mashed potatoes, cranberry sauce, and turkey gravy
- **Arrives:** cooked, ready to reheat


[Roasted Turkey + Sides Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-original-turkey/turkey-dinner-for-6-8)


### Whitt’s Barbecue’s Hickory-Smoked Pulled Turkey Dinner for 6-8


Whitt’s Barbecue in Athens, Alabama, smokes its turkey overnight over hickory on a brick pit built in 1975, then serves it with Alabama-style white sauce.


- **Serves:** 6-8
- **Includes:** 4 lbs. of hickory-smoked pulled turkey, white sauce, and a quart of your choice of side, including baked beans or Brunswick stew
- **Arrives:** cooked, ready to reheat


[Hickory-Smoked Pulled Turkey Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/whitts-barbecue/hickory-smoked-pulled-turkey-dinner-for-6-8)


### Mighty Quinn’s BBQ’s Smoked Turkey Breast + Gravy & Cranberry Sauce


New York’s Mighty Quinn’s smokes its turkey breast for three hours over white oak, apple, and cherry woods.


- **Serves:** 8-10
- **Includes:** a fully cooked 5 lb. smoked turkey breast, turkey gravy, and citrus cranberry sauce, with optional sweet potato casserole or mac & cheese
- **Arrives:** fully cooked, ready to reheat


[Smoked Turkey Breast + Gravy & Cranberry Sauce >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/mighty-quinns-bbq/smoked-turkey-breast-gravy-and-cranberry-sauce)


**Read More:[Why the Best Thanksgiving Turkey is Smoked](https://blog.goldbelly.com/thanksgiving-smoked-turkey/)**


## **Thanksgiving Dinners for a Crowd (20+)**


For 20 or more guests, a turducken or a full BBQ feast is the easiest way to feed everyone.


### Gourmet Butcher Block’s The All-Madden Turducken


Glenn Mistich of Gourmet Butcher Block created the original turducken and famously presented it to broadcaster John Madden before a Rams-Saints game in 1996.


- **Serves:** 20-25
- **What it is:** a deboned turkey stuffed with a duck stuffed with a chicken, layered with sausage stuffing and cornbread dressing, weighing about 16-18 lbs., with optional dressing add-ons


[The All-Madden Turducken >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/gourmet-butcher-block/23556-the-all-madden-turducken)


**Read More:[Turducken vs. Turkey: Which Is Better for Thanksgiving?](https://blog.goldbelly.com/turkey-vs-turducken/)**


### Cooper’s Old Time Pit Bar-B-Que’s Holiday Turkey Breast + Ham + Pie Feast for 24-28


Cooper’s in Llano, Texas, smokes its meats “cowboy-style” over mesquite embers, and this holiday feast feeds a crowd.


- **Serves:** 24-28
- **Includes:** hickory-smoked turkey breast, hickory-smoked ham, and a classic pecan pie


[Holiday Turkey Breast + Ham + Pie Feast >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/coopers-old-time-pit-bar-b-que/holiday-turkey-breast-ham-pie-feast-for-24-28)

### Heritage Foods’ Fresh Whole Heritage Thanksgiving Turkey


Brooklyn’s Heritage Foods ships certified heritage-breed turkeys, raw and ready to roast at home.


- **Serves:** 6-8 to 14-16, depending on the size you choose (8 to 18 lbs.)
- **Includes:** a stock kit with the neck and trimmings for gravy or stuffing
- **Arrives:** raw, ready to cook


[Fresh Whole Heritage Turkey >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/heritage-foods/fresh-whole-heritage-turkey)


### Terry Black’s Barbecue’s Smoked Turkey Breast


Michael and Mark Black carry on four generations of Texas barbecue at their Austin restaurant, where this turkey breast is dry-rubbed and slow-smoked over post oak.


- **Arrives:** ready to reheat


[Smoked Turkey Breast >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/terry-blacks-barbecue/smoked-turkey-breast)

## **Vegetarian & Vegan Thanksgiving Dinners**


Vegetarian guests deserve a centerpiece too, and these two are hearty enough to share with everyone.


### Gramercy Tavern’s Mushroom Lasagna for 4


Gramercy Tavern, the New York restaurant founded by Danny Meyer and Tom Colicchio, makes a mushroom lasagna that works as a vegetarian main or a side.


- **Serves:** 4


[Mushroom Lasagna for 4 >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/gramercy-tavern/gramercy-tavern-mushroom-lasagna-for-4)


### B-More Pies’ Vegan Ratatouille Pie


John and Mary Wortman founded B-More Pies in Baltimore’s Canton neighborhood in 2012, and this vegan pie is loaded with roasted vegetables.


- **Serves:** 8
- **What it is:** a 10″ pie of roasted squash, eggplant, zucchini, garlic, onion, and oregano in tomato sauce, with an olive oil-brushed crust


[Vegan Ratatouille Pie >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/b-more-pies/16124-ratatouille-pie)


## **Thanksgiving Dinner Delivery FAQs**


**How far in advance should I order Thanksgiving dinner online?**


Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, 2026. Order 1–2 weeks before for the best selection, since popular Thanksgiving dinners can sell out as the holiday gets closer. Select your delivery date at checkout, and your order will ship to arrive fresh on or before Thanksgiving, depending on the maker’s production schedule.


**Does Thanksgiving dinner delivery arrive hot?**


No. Thanksgiving dinners ship nationwide, so they arrive cooked and ready to reheat, not hot. Whole turkeys like Heritage Foods’ heritage turkey arrive raw for you to roast. Each product page has heating instructions.


**What’s the best Thanksgiving dinner to order for a big group?**


Gourmet Butcher Block’s All-Madden Turducken serves 20-25, and Cooper’s Holiday Turkey Breast + Ham + Pie Feast serves 24-28. For more options, browse[Thanksgiving feast kits](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/thanksgiving-feast-kits) .


**Can I send Thanksgiving dinner to someone else?**


Yes. Every dinner can ship to any address in the U.S., and you can add a personalized message at checkout. It’s an easy way to feed family who can’t travel this year.
